other_conditions: Candidate must have passed the qualifying examination prescribed for the specific training programme or course.
Benefits can be availed by a particular candidate only once, irrespective of the sector or nature of training.
Candidates who have already completed skilling training in any trade under any government scheme are not eligible for benefits under this scheme.
Students/candidates must attend all mandatory training sessions prescribed for the course.
If a candidate leaves the training midway, the entire expenditure incurred on the candidate will be recovered from the institute or candidate jointly.
40% of the sanctioned slots are earmarked for female candidates; remaining slots may be filled by male candidates if sufficient female candidates are unavailable.
benefits_summary: Provides market‑driven skill development training in sectors such as Tourism, IT, Handicrafts, Retail, Agriculture, Construction and other focus areas to enhance employability of youth in Jammu & Kashmir.
application_link: Applicants have to register themselves into the portal.
